# Presentiq

> Presentiq is a presentation design agency for businesses and decision-makers, based in Germany. It designs corporate, sales, pitch and investor presentations, PowerPoint and Office templates, Word documents and interactive PDFs, and provides day-to-day presentation design support — in PowerPoint, Google Slides and Canva, in English and German.

Presentiq GmbH focuses on presentations and everything around them instead of offering every kind of design. It works closely with its parent company K16 on content strategy. Clients work directly with the people designing their presentation, with no handovers. Work is done in Germany under GDPR; an NDA is available on request.

Client satisfaction (automated client survey): average rating 1.34 on the German grade scale (1 = best), 60 template projects, more than 1,100 presentation projects.

Contact: kontakt@presentiq.de, +49 172 88 77 619, https://presentiq.de/en/contact

## Services

- [Corporate presentations](https://presentiq.de/en/services/company-presentations): company, product, pitch and investor presentations, board and AGM presentations.
- [Presentation design support](https://presentiq.de/en/services/presentation-design): fast, reliable design support for urgent requests and tight deadlines, on-brand redesign of existing slides, weekend and overnight support on request.
- [Templates](https://presentiq.de/en/services/templates): PowerPoint and Office templates, slide libraries and guidelines.
- [Word and Adobe PDF](https://presentiq.de/en/services/word-and-adobe-pdf): Word formatting, interactive PDFs, brochures and flyers.
- [AI design](https://presentiq.de/en/services/ai-support): short films, image compositions, illustrations and infographics; refining AI-generated drafts into polished, on-brand presentations.
- [Storytelling](https://presentiq.de/en/services/storytelling): structure and narrative flow, copywriting and key messages for a specific audience.

## Case studies

- [International automotive group](https://presentiq.de/en/international-automotive-group): 25 presentations for one international event, consistent with strict corporate design guidelines.
- [PowerPoint to Google Slides](https://presentiq.de/en/powerpoint-to-google-slides): moving a major German corporation's key presentations to Google Slides.
- [Corporate presentations](https://presentiq.de/en/corporate-presentations): turning a standard company deck into a sales tool.
- [Pitch and investor presentations for SMEs](https://presentiq.de/en/pitch-investor-presentations-smes): sharpening the story, argument and design of a pitch deck.
